text: {"432":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The macro-expansion driver detects when its expansion loop cannot make progress and treats that as an error."},"433":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The unresolved-macro work queue is part of the macro-expansion algorithm."},"434":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_resolve"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro expansion manages the invocation queue while name resolution resolves imports and macro names during the loop."},"435":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_resolve"],"refers":[],"why":"Expansion processes resolved invocations, while resolution determines unresolved macros and imports that can leave the loop without progress."},"436":{"about":["rustc_expand","rustc_resolve"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro expansion and its associated import/macro resolution recover from unresolved items so compilation can continue to produce diagnostics."}}
